record.paper_title: PURE O-SEQUENCES: KNOWN RESULTS, APPLICATIONS AND OPEN PROBLEMS
record.original_question: Is every matroid h-vector a pure O-sequence? Equivalently, does Stanley's conjecture hold for all matroid complexes, beyond the low-dimensional cases proved in the paper and cited work?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.4. Any matroid h-vector is a pure O-sequence.
However, the conjecture remains open in general.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions.

(1) A pure multicomplex is a finite, nonempty collection X of monomials in a polynomial ring k[x_1,...,x_n] (with 1 ∈ X) that is closed under taking divisors and whose maximal monomials all have the same total degree. The h-vector (or O-sequence) of X is the integer vector h = (h_0, h_1, h_2, ...), where h_i is the number of monomials in X of total degree i. A finite sequence of nonnegative integers is called a pure O-sequence if it arises in this way from some pure multicomplex.

(2) A matroid M on a finite ground set E is a nonempty collection of subsets of E (the independent sets) closed under taking subsets and satisfying the exchange axiom: for all I, J independent with |I| < |J|, there exists e ∈ J \ I such that I ∪ {e} is independent. The independence complex Δ(M) is the simplicial complex on E whose faces are the independent sets of M; it is a pure simplicial complex of dimension r−1, where r is the rank of M. The h-vector of M is defined to be the h-vector of Δ(M), i.e. the vector h(M) = (h_0,...,h_r) determined by the f-vector (f_{−1}, f_0,...,f_{r−1}) of Δ(M) via the identity 
   ∑_{i=0}^{r} f_{i−1} (t−1)^{r−i} = ∑_{i=0}^{r} h_i t^{r−i}.

Problem. Prove or disprove: for every matroid M, the h-vector h(M) is a pure O-sequence.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that every matroid h-vector is a pure O-sequence (Stanley's conjecture) remains open in general. Partial results have been established, including the cases of rank ≤ 3 matroids, cographic matroids, internally perfect matroids, certain coned/biconed/triconed graphic matroids, and (in 2021–2023) positroids, but the full conjecture is still unresolved.

status_evidence.title: The h-vector of a Positroid is a pure O-sequence
status_evidence.snippet: We prove Stanley's conjecture for the class of positroids, while the general conjecture remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Positroid case proved; general matroid case still open.

status_evidence.title: Triconed Graphs, weighted forests, and h-vectors of matroid complexes
status_evidence.snippet: Verifies Stanley's conjecture for triconed graphic matroids, contributing partial progress.
status_evidence.claim: Further partial progress on graphic matroids; full conjecture not settled.

status_evidence.title: Pure O-Sequences and Matroid h-Vectors
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Stanley's conjecture that matroid h-vectors are pure O-sequences and proves several special cases.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture is the central open problem of the area.
